title: My 3rd Person Action Moba
author: Izkimar
selftext:
I've been working on a third-person MOBA for a few weeks and just added a new battleground called Dragonscrest.

This one is my take on a brawly ARAM-style map, with a couple of side objectives to keep things interesting.

I built this using Opus 5.5 inside of Spawn. All of the character models were made with the agent using Blender, and the environment assets are all bespoke geometry.

Still lots of work to do, but I'm pretty happy with how this map is coming together.

You can try it here: [https://www.spawn.co/@izkimar/league-of-spawn/play](https://www.spawn.co/@izkimar/league-of-spawn/play). Would love to get some feedback!

comments.author: romansamurai
comments.body: What was your process for the characters, for me opus is bad with blender for almost any kind of characters. Headless or mcp.

replies.author: Izkimar
replies.body:
Yeah I've had similar experiences but was able to get some decent ones with lots of iteration. I worked with the agent to first hone in on an art style that it could actually pull off to a decent degree. 

This was going through lots of art refs online and then generating lots of 2D art till we nailed it down. Then from there, For each character will generate the art in that style, multiple pose angles, full material reference sheets and anatomy reference sheets generated. 

Then I also take an extra step of generating a Tripo model for it to reference to improve shaping. This mainly was critical for female heads as it really struggled with the topology there. Then it would build them in headless blender using the 2D art refs and tripo refs to guide.

replies.author: romansamurai
replies.body: Hmm. Curious. And yeah. I tried high quality (full 2000000 triangles) Tripo models so opus can rotate it and look at it from all angles it needs and it still seems so bad. With Astra, the iterations were at least getting better because it was trying to improve overall to be concept or the original. But opus seems to struggle to tell how far away it is from the concept. It’ll move on to other parts even when iterating because it thinks that part is good enough even when it’s not even close. It’s frustrating. I’ll keep trying tho. Thanks for the reply. Good luck with your game. Looks great already!
